conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Superposition means a quantum bit, or qubit, can be both 0 and 1 simultaneously, unlike a classical bit. Entanglement is when two or more qubits become linked, so the state of one instantly influences the others, no matter the distance.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For instance, superposition allows a quantum computer to explore many possibilities at once, like trying all paths in a maze simultaneously. Entanglement enables qubits to work together on a problem, leading to exponentially faster calculations.
